name: Cheesy Road
author: panharathsok
description: Help Pepper, the adorable daring cat, in "Cheesy Road"! Deliver delicious pizzas across three challenging levels while evading the devious rat mafia on your pink scooter. Navigate tight city corners, suburban chaos, and the spooky sewers on this sizzling adventure. Avenge the spirit of your predecessor delivery boy with each successful delivery. Will you save the stomachs of the city or melt under the cheesy pressure? Sharpen your claws, it's time to make a purr-fect delivery!
